selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Why did the traveler begin a new journey?
questions.answer: He wanted to see the proofs that Allah is One.

questions.question: What did the traveler want to find with great certainty?
questions.answer: He wanted to find his Creator and know Allah for sure.

questions.question: Who did the traveler speak to before starting the new journey?
questions.answer: He spoke to his intellect.

questions.question: Where had the traveler traveled in his mind before this new journey?
questions.answer: He had traveled through the whole universe.

questions.question: What was the traveler asking all things about?
questions.answer: He was asking about his Creator.

questions.question: At the first stopping-place, how many holy truths did they see?
questions.answer: They saw four.

questions.question: Where were those four truths seen to be working?
questions.answer: They were seen over all the universe.

questions.question: What did those four truths clearly require?
questions.answer: They required the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: Who was sent to the world to gain faith?
questions.answer: A traveler was sent.

questions.question: Why did the traveler look in every place?
questions.answer: He wanted to seek his Lord and find Allah.

questions.question: Did the traveler only look at one small part of creation or all of it in his mind?
questions.answer: He looked at all of it in his mind.

questions.question: After reaching certainty about necessary existence, what did he want to learn next?
questions.answer: He wanted to learn the proofs of Allah’s unity.

questions.question: Who went together on this new journey?
questions.answer: The traveler and his intellect went together.

questions.question: What happened at the first stopping-place?
questions.answer: They saw four sacred truths.

questions.question: What big belief do those truths support?
questions.answer: They support believing that Allah is One.

questions.question: What did they notice there?
questions.answer: They noticed four sacred truths.

questions.question: What was the traveler’s purpose in being sent to the world?
questions.answer: His purpose was to reach faith.

questions.question: How did the traveler make his search through the cosmos?
questions.answer: He made the journey in his mind.

questions.question: What was he trying to learn from everything around him?
questions.answer: He was trying to learn about his Creator.

questions.question: What name is used for Allah in this passage when speaking about existence?
questions.answer: Allah is described as the Necessarily Existent Creator.

questions.question: What did the traveler say to begin the next part of the journey?
questions.answer: He called his intellect to come along.

questions.question: What was special about the new journey compared with the earlier search?
questions.answer: This journey focused on proofs of Allah’s unity.

questions.question: When they started together, where did they first stop?
questions.answer: They stopped at the first stopping-place.

questions.question: What kind of person is the main person in the passage?
questions.answer: He is a traveler looking for faith and truth.
